fields.label: Enable Google Sheets Sync

fields.description: Paste the full JSON key file for the service account. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Service Account JSON Key

fields.description: Share every spreadsheet with this address as an Editor.
fields.label: Service Account Email
Setup
fields.options:
1. Create a Google Cloud project and enable the Google Sheets API and Google Drive API.
  2. Create a service account and download its JSON key.
  3. Paste the key above and save.
  4. Create each spreadsheet yourself, then share it with the service account email as Editor.

The app never creates spreadsheets: files created by a service account are owned by an identity nobody can sign in as.
